intro: Lanzhou is a city squeezed into a narrow valley with the Yellow River running straight through the middle of it, and the valley walls rise steeply on both sides. For radio this means the city itself is a trench — coverage along the valley is good and coverage across the ridges is nil — while the hills immediately above are excellent sites. It is the gateway to the Hexi Corridor, so the railway west is heavy and conventional, and the airport is an hour out of town on the plateau because there is nowhere closer to put one.
introz: 兰州是一座挤在狭长河谷里的城市，黄河从中间穿城而过，两侧谷壁陡峭上升。对无线电来说，城市本身就是一条沟——沿河谷方向覆盖良好，翻过山脊则完全没有信号，而紧邻其上的山岗是绝佳站点。这里是河西走廊的门户，西行铁路运量大且以普速为主；机场则在一小时车程外的塬上，因为更近的地方根本放不下。

stations.d: Zhongchuan is seventy kilometres out on the plateau, because the valley has no room for a runway.
stations.dz: 中川机场在七十公里外的塬上，因为河谷里放不下跑道。

stations.d: A trench of a city. Along the valley simplex works well; across the ridge it does not work at all. Get above the city and everything changes.
stations.dz: 一座沟谷里的城市。沿河谷直通效果好，翻过山脊完全不通。爬到城市上方，一切就都变了。

stations.z: 无线列调 · 普速铁路调度
stations.d: The Lanxin line west into the corridor is one of the heaviest conventional freight routes in China, and the yards here work continuously.
stations.dz: 西行进入走廊的兰新线是中国运量最大的普速货运线之一，这里的编组场连续作业。

stations.z: 高铁 · GSM-R 数字系统

stations.d: Gansu traffic radio covers the corridor expressways, where dust storms and winter ice close the road regularly.
stations.dz: 甘肃交通广播覆盖走廊上的高速公路，那里沙尘暴和冬季结冰经常封路。

stations.d: Dry air and high ground. At night the band brings in Central Asia and western China clearly.
stations.dz: 空气干燥、地势高。夜间频段能清晰收到中亚和中国西部的信号。

stations.d: The markets along the river and the endless construction in the valley are both heavy users.
stations.dz: 沿河的市场和谷地里不停的施工都是重度用户。
